observation.command:
for c in "decision-log-store-service:decision_log_store_service" "graph-api:graph_api" "norm-matching:norm_matching" "subsumtion-service:subsumtion_service" "risikohinweis-service:risikohinweis_service" "ki-guv-feedback:ki_guv_feedback" "berichtskonfigurator:berichtskonfigurator"; do
  img=${c%%:*}; mod=${c##*:}
  echo "=== $img ==="
  timeout 60 docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "/app/.venv/bin/python -c 'import ${mod}; print(\"ok\")' 2>&1 | tail -1" 2>/dev/null || echo "no venv path"
done
